This Explorer comes equipped with a 2.3L EcoBoost I-4 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and intelligent four-wheel drive, delivering strong performance with an estimated 20 city and 27 highway miles per gallon. You'll appreciate the responsive handling from the four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering system, which work together to provide confidence on both highways and varied terrain.

Heated captain's chairs in the first and second rows invite relaxation, while the automatic temperature control system with separate front dual zones ensures every occupant finds their ideal setting. Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine through the navigation system, which connects with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for intuitive smartphone integration. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and the six-speaker system make managing entertainment simple and safe while driving.

Safety features are comprehensive, including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin.
